title: Over 4,000 march in Dublin to demand end to fossil fuels
description: Protesters’ specific demands included a ban on LNG terminals, as well as the publication of the 2026 Climate Action Plan, which has been delayed.

title: UN climate chief urges speed as COP31 confronts fossil fuel divide
description: UN climate chief Simon Stiell has called for swift progress in COP31 negotiations to address fossil fuel usage challenges. Countries are showing concerns about new constraints on fossil fuels.
